activity_entries_note_length.name: activity_entries_note_length
activity_entries_note_length.value: "activity_entries"."note" is null or char_length("activity_entries"."note") between 1 and 120

foods_brand_length.name: foods_brand_length
foods_brand_length.value: "foods"."brand" is null or char_length("foods"."brand") between 1 and 120

foods_serving_size.name: foods_serving_size
foods_serving_size.value:
("foods"."serving_amount" is null) = ("foods"."serving_unit" is null)
				and ("foods"."serving_amount" is null or ("foods"."basis" = 'serving' and "foods"."serving_amount" > 0))

label_scan_edits_counts.name: label_scan_edits_counts
label_scan_edits_counts.value:
"label_scan_edits"."proposed" between 0 and 100 and "label_scan_edits"."changed" >= 0 and "label_scan_edits"."removed" >= 0
				and "label_scan_edits"."changed" + "label_scan_edits"."removed" <= "label_scan_edits"."proposed" and "label_scan_edits"."added" between 0 and 100

diary_entries_shape.name: diary_entries_shape
diary_entries_shape.value:
("diary_entries"."kind" = 'food' and "diary_entries"."food" is not null and "diary_entries"."amount" > 0 and "diary_entries"."unit" is not null)
				or ("diary_entries"."kind" = 'quick' and "diary_entries"."food" is null and "diary_entries"."amount" is null and "diary_entries"."unit" is null
					and "diary_entries"."food_id" is null and ("diary_entries"."nutrients" -> 'energy_kcal') is not null)

saved_meal_items_shape.name: saved_meal_items_shape
saved_meal_items_shape.value:
("saved_meal_items"."kind" = 'food' and "saved_meal_items"."food" is not null and "saved_meal_items"."amount" > 0 and "saved_meal_items"."unit" is not null)
				or ("saved_meal_items"."kind" = 'quick' and "saved_meal_items"."food" is null and "saved_meal_items"."amount" is null and "saved_meal_items"."unit" is null
					and "saved_meal_items"."food_id" is null and ("saved_meal_items"."nutrients" -> 'energy_kcal') is not null)

goal_versions_base_burn.name: goal_versions_base_burn
goal_versions_base_burn.value:
("goal_versions"."mode" = 'none') = ("goal_versions"."base_burn_kcal" is null)
				and ("goal_versions"."base_burn_kcal" is null or "goal_versions"."base_burn_kcal" between 500 and 10000)

goal_versions_fat_share_range.name: goal_versions_fat_share_range
goal_versions_fat_share_range.value:
"goal_versions"."fat_share" is null or ("goal_versions"."fat_share" between 0 and 1
				and ("goal_versions"."macro_mode" = 'percent' or "goal_versions"."fat_share" between 0.1 and 0.7))

goal_versions_macro_shares.name: goal_versions_macro_shares
goal_versions_macro_shares.value:
case when "goal_versions"."macro_mode" = 'percent'
				then coalesce("goal_versions"."protein_share" between 0 and 1 and "goal_versions"."carb_share" between 0 and 1
					and "goal_versions"."protein_share" + "goal_versions"."carb_share" + "goal_versions"."fat_share" = 1, false)
				else "goal_versions"."protein_share" is null and "goal_versions"."carb_share" is null end

achievements_level.name: achievements_level
achievements_level.value:
("achievements"."kind" in ('weight', 'goal') and "achievements"."level" ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,2})?$')
				or ("achievements"."kind" = 'streak' and "achievements"."level" ~ '^[0-9]{1,4}$')
				or ("achievements"."kind" = 'first' and "achievements"."level" in ('weigh_in', 'day_logged', 'complete_day', 'scan', 'voice', 'recipe'))

model_choices_allowed.name: model_choices_allowed
model_choices_allowed.value: ("model_choices"."speak" = 'server' or "model_choices"."speak_allowed_at" is not null) and ("model_choices"."scan" = 'server' or "model_choices"."scan_allowed_at" is not null)
